name: security-panel
title: Account Security Panel
description: fa-auth admin-tier privileged-action audit log on the canonical data-table plus the two superuser-only retention purges, each behind a confirmation naming the retention floor. Gated by the package's RequireRole (role hierarchy for the log, dual evidence for the purges) and driven by useAuditLog + useSecurityPurges. Requires @mano8/astro-auth-m8 installed.
